nodes.label: Grammar: S + V + 了 + Duration + O (duration of a completed action)
Grammar: S + V + 了 + Duration + O + 了 (duration of an action still going on)
Grammar: 对……感兴趣 / 对……有兴趣 (negatives 不感兴趣 / 没(有)兴趣; degree adverb goes before 感兴趣/有兴趣)
Grammar Note: 一刻钟 is a period of time meaning 15 minutes (not a clock time)
Grammar: 又 + V (recurrence that has already happened)
Grammar: 再 + V (recurrence that has not happened yet)
Grammar: Interrogative pronoun + 就 + same interrogative pronoun (uncertain person/thing/manner; second subject goes before 就)
十点半 (shí diǎn bàn) - half past ten, 10:30
做作业 (zuò zuòyè) - to do homework
锻炼 (duànliàn) - to exercise
吃晚饭 (chī wǎnfàn) - to have dinner
看电视 (kàn diànshì) - to watch TV
上网 (shàng wǎng) - to go online
睡觉 (shuì jiào) - to sleep
谁 (shéi) - who
一点半 (yī diǎn bàn) - half past one, 1:30
十二点一刻 (shí'èr diǎn yí kè) - a quarter past twelve, 12:15
十二点三刻 / 差一刻一点 (shí'èr diǎn sān kè / chà yí kè yī diǎn) - a quarter to one, 12:45
差五分十二点 (chà wǔ fēn shí'èr diǎn) - five minutes to twelve, 11:55

周经理呢？ (Zhōu jīnglǐ ne?) - Where is Manager Zhou?
回得来。 (Huí de lái.) - (He) can get back in time.
好啊，怎么了？ (Hǎo a, zěnme le?) - Sure, what's the matter?
没问题，我帮你。 (Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ.) - No problem, I'll help you.
我们什么时候吃晚饭？ (Wǒmen shénme shíhou chī wǎnfàn?) - When shall we have dinner?
那我们现在走吧。 (Nà wǒmen xiànzài zǒu ba.) - Then let's go now.
周明要找什么？为什么？ (Zhōu Míng yào zhǎo shénme? Wèi shénme?) - What does Zhou Ming want to find? Why?
周明的儿子做完作业了吗？ (Zhōu Míng de érzi zuòwán zuòyè le ma?) - Has Zhou Ming's son finished his homework?
周明儿子的同学一会儿要做什么？ (Zhōu Míng érzi de tóngxué yíhuìr yào zuò shénme?) - What is Zhou Ming's son's classmate going to do in a moment?
小刚今天怎么了？为什么？ (Xiǎogāng jīntiān zěnme le? Wèi shénme?) - What is the matter with Xiaogang today? Why?
周明在喝什么？ (Zhōu Míng zài hē shénme?) - What is Zhou Ming drinking?
周明喝牛奶了吗？为什么？ (Zhōu Míng hē niúnǎi le ma? Wèi shénme?) - Did Zhou Ming drink milk? Why?
刚才你做什么了？ (Gāngcái nǐ zuò shénme le?) - What did you do just now?
刚才我出去买饮料了。 (Gāngcái wǒ chūqu mǎi yǐnliào le.) - Just now I went out to buy a drink.
马可，你看得懂中国电影吗？ (Mǎkě, nǐ kàn de dǒng Zhōngguó diànyǐng ma?) - Marco, can you understand Chinese movies?
我看得懂中国电影。 (Wǒ kàn de dǒng Zhōngguó diànyǐng.) - I can understand Chinese movies.
你听得懂汉语歌吗？ (Nǐ tīng de dǒng Hànyǔ gē ma?) - Can you understand Chinese songs?
我听不懂汉语歌。 (Wǒ tīng bu dǒng Hànyǔ gē.) - I cannot understand Chinese songs.
马可看得懂中国电影，听不懂汉语歌。 (Mǎkě kàn de dǒng Zhōngguó diànyǐng, tīng bu dǒng Hànyǔ gē.) - Marco can understand Chinese movies but cannot understand Chinese songs.
万事开头难。 (Wàn shì kāitóu nán.) - The first step is always the hardest.
"万事开头难"的意思是，做什么事情都是开始的时候比较难。 ("Wàn shì kāitóu nán" de yìsi shì, zuò shénme shìqing dōu shì kāishǐ de shíhou bǐjiào nán.) - "万事开头难" means that whatever one does, it is harder at the start.

这句话告诉我们，开始做事情的时候遇到困难是正常的，不要因此而放弃，要坚持下去，以后会越做越容易，越来越好。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen, kāishǐ zuò shìqing de shíhou yùdào kùnnan shì zhèngcháng de, bú yào yīncǐ ér fàngqì, yào jiānchí xiàqu, yǐhòu huì yuè zuò yuè róngyì, yuè lái yuè hǎo.) - This saying tells us that meeting difficulties at the start is normal; do not give up because of them but persevere, and it will get easier and better.
那个漂亮的新同事是谁？ (Nàge piàoliang de xīn tóngshì shì shéi?) - Who is that pretty new colleague?
那是小丽。 (Nà shì Xiǎolì.) - That is Xiaoli.
她刚来北京吗？ (Tā gāng lái Běijīng ma?) - Has she just come to Beijing?
不，她在北京工作三年了。 (Bù, tā zài Běijīng gōngzuò sān nián le.) - No, she has worked in Beijing for three years.
以前她在哪儿工作？ (Yǐqián tā zài nǎr gōngzuò?) - Where did she work before?
她在银行工作了两年以后来的我们公司。 (Tā zài yínháng gōngzuòle liǎng nián yǐhòu lái de wǒmen gōngsī.) - She came to our company after working in a bank for two years.
周末你跟小丽去哪儿玩儿了？ (Zhōumò nǐ gēn Xiǎolì qù nǎr wánr le?) - Where did you and Xiaoli go to have fun at the weekend?
我们去唱歌了。 (Wǒmen qù chàng gē le.) - We went to sing.
你们唱了多久？ (Nǐmen chàngle duō jiǔ?) - How long did you sing?
我们唱了两个小时歌，晚上还去听音乐会了。 (Wǒmen chàngle liǎng ge xiǎoshí gē, wǎnshang hái qù tīng yīnyuèhuì le.) - We sang for two hours, and in the evening we also went to a concert.
你们都对音乐感兴趣吗？ (Nǐmen dōu duì yīnyuè gǎn xìngqù ma?) - Are you both interested in music?
她对音乐感兴趣，我对她更感兴趣。 (Tā duì yīnyuè gǎn xìngqù, wǒ duì tā gèng gǎn xìngqù.) - She is interested in music; I am even more interested in her.
我跟小丽下个月结婚，到时候欢迎你来。 (Wǒ gēn Xiǎolì xià ge yuè jié hūn, dào shíhou huānyíng nǐ lái.) - Xiaoli and I are getting married next month; you are welcome to come then.
什么？结婚？ (Shénme? Jié hūn?) - What? Getting married?
对啊，突然吗？ (Duì a, tūrán ma?) - Yes, is it sudden?
你们不是刚认识吗？ (Nǐmen bú shì gāng rènshi ma?) - Didn't you only just meet?
我跟她都认识五年了。 (Wǒ gēn tā dōu rènshi wǔ nián le.) - She and I have already known each other for five years.
你跟她结婚，那我怎么办啊？ (Nǐ gēn tā jié hūn, nà wǒ zěnme bàn a?) - You're marrying her, so what am I to do?
你看看手表，怎么迟到了？ (Nǐ kànkan shǒubiǎo, zěnme chídào le?) - Look at your watch, why are you late?
没迟到啊。 (Méi chídào a.) - I'm not late.
你不是说七点半来接我吗？ (Nǐ bú shì shuō qī diǎn bàn lái jiē wǒ ma?) - Didn't you say you would come to pick me up at half past seven?
你迟到了一刻钟。 (Nǐ chídàole yí kè zhōng.) - You are a quarter of an hour late.
现在不是七点半吗？ (Xiànzài bú shì qī diǎn bàn ma?) - Isn't it half past seven now?
已经差一刻八点了！ (Yǐjīng chà yí kè bā diǎn le!) - It is already a quarter to eight!
我都在这儿坐了半个小时了。 (Wǒ dōu zài zhèr zuòle bàn ge xiǎoshí le.) - I have been sitting here for half an hour already.
不是我迟到了，是你的表快了一刻钟。 (Bú shì wǒ chídào le, shì nǐ de biǎo kuàile yí kè zhōng.) - It's not that I am late; your watch is a quarter of an hour fast.
她工作了三年。 (Tā gōngzuòle sān nián.) - She worked for three years.
我们坐了一个小时公共汽车。 (Wǒmen zuòle yí ge xiǎoshí gōnggòng qìchē.) - We took the bus for an hour.
你怎么晚到了一刻钟？ (Nǐ zěnme wǎn dàole yí kè zhōng?) - Why did you arrive a quarter of an hour late?
我们唱了两个小时歌。 (Wǒmen chàngle liǎng ge xiǎoshí gē.) - We sang for two hours.
看了一个小时书了。 (Kànle yí ge xiǎoshí shū le.) - (Someone) has been reading for an hour (and is still reading).
我学习了一年汉语了。 (Wǒ xuéxíle yì nián Hànyǔ le.) - I have been studying Chinese for a year.
她看了半个小时电视了。 (Tā kànle bàn ge xiǎoshí diànshì le.) - She has been watching TV for half an hour.
他们游了二十分钟泳了。 (Tāmen yóule èrshí fēnzhōng yǒng le.) - They have been swimming for twenty minutes.
我都在这儿坐了半个小时了。 (Wǒ dōu zài zhèr zuòle bàn ge xiǎoshí le.) - I have been sitting here for half an hour already.
你学了多长时间汉语了？ (Nǐ xuéle duō cháng shíjiān Hànyǔ le?) - How long have you been studying Chinese?
我在这个地方住了十年了。 (Wǒ zài zhège dìfang zhùle shí nián le.) - I have lived in this place for ten years.
小王还没来，你等了他多长时间？ (Xiǎo Wáng hái méi lái, nǐ děngle tā duō cháng shíjiān?) - Xiao Wang hasn't come yet; how long have you waited for him?
他们对电影感兴趣。 (Tāmen duì diànyǐng gǎn xìngqù.) - They are interested in movies.
我儿子对打篮球不感兴趣。 (Wǒ érzi duì dǎ lánqiú bù gǎn xìngqù.) - My son is not interested in playing basketball.
同学们对汉语有兴趣。 (Tóngxuémen duì Hànyǔ yǒu xìngqù.) - The students are interested in Chinese.
你们都对音乐感兴趣吗？ (Nǐmen dōu duì yīnyuè gǎn xìngqù ma?) - Are you all interested in music?
我对她更感兴趣。 (Wǒ duì tā gèng gǎn xìngqù.) - I am even more interested in her.
你对什么运动感兴趣？ (Nǐ duì shénme yùndòng gǎn xìngqù?) - What sports are you interested in?
你喜欢汉语吗？ (Nǐ xǐhuan Hànyǔ ma?) - Do you like Chinese?
我不喜欢听音乐。 (Wǒ bù xǐhuan tīng yīnyuè.) - I don't like listening to music.
我等了你一刻钟。 (Wǒ děngle nǐ yí kè zhōng.) - I waited for you for a quarter of an hour (15 minutes).
以前她在哪儿工作？ (Yǐqián tā zài nǎr gōngzuò?) - Where did she work before?
你们唱了多久？ (Nǐmen chàngle duō jiǔ?) - How long did you sing?
我跟小丽下个月结婚。 (Wǒ gēn Xiǎolì xià ge yuè jié hūn.) - Xiaoli and I are getting married next month.
（你）怎么迟到了？ ((Nǐ) zěnme chídào le?) - Why are (you) late?
你迟到了一刻钟。 (Nǐ chídàole yí kè zhōng.) - You were a quarter of an hour late.
对不起，我起晚了。 (Duìbuqǐ, wǒ qǐ wǎn le.) - Sorry, I got up late.
你现在要去哪儿？ (Nǐ xiànzài yào qù nǎr?) - Where are you going now?
比赛什么时候开始？ (Bǐsài shénme shíhou kāishǐ?) - When does the match start?
一直往前走，超市的旁边。 (Yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, chāoshì de pángbiān.) - Go straight ahead, next to the supermarket.
什么？你们不是刚认识吗？ (Shénme? Nǐmen bú shì gāng rènshi ma?) - What? Didn't you only just meet?
我再玩儿十分钟。 (Wǒ zài wánr shí fēnzhōng.) - I'll play for ten more minutes.
你已经玩儿了好几个小时了，不累吗？ (Nǐ yǐjīng wánrle hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí le, bú lèi ma?) - You've already played for several hours; aren't you tired?
你一直在这家公司工作吗？ (Nǐ yìzhí zài zhè jiā gōngsī gōngzuò ma?) - Have you always worked at this company?
我特别喜欢我的工作。 (Wǒ tèbié xǐhuan wǒ de gōngzuò.) - I especially like my job.
喂，你在哪儿呢？ (Wéi, nǐ zài nǎr ne?) - Hello, where are you?
好，你别着急，我快到了。 (Hǎo, nǐ bié zháojí, wǒ kuài dào le.) - OK, don't worry, I'm almost there.
你们身体怎么这么好？ (Nǐmen shēntǐ zěnme zhème hǎo?) - How come you are in such good health?
快50年了。 (Kuài wǔshí nián le.) - It's almost 50 years.
小丽以前在哪儿工作？工作了多长时间？ (Xiǎolì yǐqián zài nǎr gōngzuò? Gōngzuòle duō cháng shíjiān?) - Where did Xiaoli work before? How long did she work there?
小刚和小丽周末做什么了？做了多长时间？ (Xiǎogāng hé Xiǎolì zhōumò zuò shénme le? Zuòle duō cháng shíjiān?) - What did Xiaogang and Xiaoli do at the weekend? How long did they do it?
小丽对什么很感兴趣？小刚呢？ (Xiǎolì duì shénme hěn gǎn xìngqù? Xiǎogāng ne?) - What is Xiaoli very interested in? And Xiaogang?
小刚和小丽什么时候结婚？ (Xiǎogāng hé Xiǎolì shénme shíhou jié hūn?) - When are Xiaogang and Xiaoli getting married?
同事为什么觉得小刚结婚很突然？ (Tóngshì wèi shénme juéde Xiǎogāng jié hūn hěn tūrán?) - Why does the colleague think Xiaogang's marriage is very sudden?
小刚迟到了吗？为什么？ (Xiǎogāng chídào le ma? Wèi shénme?) - Was Xiaogang late? Why?

我对游泳很感兴趣，我是5岁学会游泳的，到现在已经游了20年了。 (Wǒ duì yóuyǒng hěn gǎn xìngqù, wǒ shì wǔ suì xuéhuì yóuyǒng de, dào xiànzài yǐjīng yóule èrshí nián le.) - I am very interested in swimming; I learned to swim at the age of 5, and by now I have been swimming for 20 years.
上1个小时汉语课 (Shàng yí ge xiǎoshí Hànyǔ kè) - Have a one-hour Chinese class
一步走错步步错。 (Yí bù zǒucuò bùbù cuò.) - One wrong move makes all moves wrong.

"一步走错步步错"的意思是，下棋的时候，如果有一步走错了，那么以后的每一步都是错的。 ("Yí bù zǒucuò bùbù cuò" de yìsi shì, xià qí de shíhou, rúguǒ yǒu yí bù zǒucuò le, nàme yǐhòu de měi yí bù dōu shì cuò de.) - It means that in a chess game, if one move is wrong, then every later move will be wrong too.

这句话用来比喻如果我们开始时做了一个错误的决定，那么以后的每一次决定都会是错的。 (Zhè jù huà yònglái bǐyù rúguǒ wǒmen kāishǐ shí zuòle yí ge cuòwù de juédìng, nàme yǐhòu de měi yí cì juédìng dōu huì shì cuò de.) - Metaphorically, it means that if we make a wrong decision at the start, every decision after it will be wrong.

这句话告诉我们，做事情的时候每一步都要谨慎，避免出现错误，尤其是开始的时候。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen, zuò shìqing de shíhou měi yí bù dōu yào jǐnshèn, bìmiǎn chūxiàn cuòwù, yóuqí shì kāishǐ de shíhou.) - This saying tells us to be prudent at every step, to avoid mistakes, especially at the beginning.
听说你最近打算买房子？ (Tīngshuō nǐ zuìjìn dǎsuàn mǎi fángzi?) - I heard you plan to buy a house recently?

是，昨天去看了看，今天又去看了看，明天还要再去看看。 (Shì, zuótiān qù kànle kàn, jīntiān yòu qù kànle kàn, míngtiān hái yào zài qù kànkan.) - Yes. I went to have a look yesterday, went to look again today, and will go and look again tomorrow.
都不满意吗？ (Dōu bù mǎnyì ma?) - Are none of them satisfactory?
一个没有电梯，不方便。 (Yí ge méiyǒu diàntī, bù fāngbiàn.) - One has no elevator, which is inconvenient.
一个有电梯，但是在二十层。 (Yí ge yǒu diàntī, dànshì zài èrshí céng.) - One has an elevator, but it is on the twentieth floor.
二十层怎么了？ (Èrshí céng zěnme le?) - What's wrong with the twentieth floor?
太高了，往下看多害怕啊！ (Tài gāo le, wǎng xià kàn duō hài pà a!) - It's too high; how scary it is to look down!
听说你下个星期就要回国了？ (Tīngshuō nǐ xià ge xīngqī jiù yào huí guó le?) - I heard you are going back to your country next week?
是啊，真不想离开北京。 (Shì a, zhēn bù xiǎng líkāi Běijīng.) - Yes, I really don't want to leave Beijing.
我下星期不在北京，不能去机场送你了。 (Wǒ xià xīngqī bú zài Běijīng, bù néng qù jīchǎng sòng nǐ le.) - I won't be in Beijing next week, so I can't go to the airport to see you off.
没关系，你忙吧。 (Méi guānxi, nǐ máng ba.) - It doesn't matter, you go ahead and be busy.
这个小熊猫送给你，欢迎你以后再到中国来。 (Zhège xiǎo xióngmāo sòng gěi nǐ, huānyíng nǐ yǐhòu zài dào Zhōngguó lái.) - This little panda is a gift for you; you are welcome to come to China again in the future.
谢谢。 (Xièxie.) - Thank you.
希望以后能再见面。 (Xīwàng yǐhòu néng zài jiàn miàn.) - I hope we can meet again in the future.
小刚，我们坐哪儿？ (Xiǎogāng, wǒmen zuò nǎr?) - Xiaogang, where shall we sit?
你坐哪儿我就坐哪儿。 (Nǐ zuò nǎr wǒ jiù zuò nǎr.) - I'll sit wherever you sit.
坐这儿吧，这儿安静。 (Zuò zhèr ba, zhèr ānjìng.) - Let's sit here; it's quiet here.
你想喝什么饮料？ (Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme yǐnliào?) - What drink would you like?
你喝什么我就喝什么。 (Nǐ hē shénme wǒ jiù hē shénme.) - I'll drink whatever you drink.
喝可乐吧。 (Hē kělè ba.) - Let's have cola.
你等我一会儿，我马上回来。 (Nǐ děng wǒ yíhuìr, wǒ mǎshàng huílai.) - Wait for me a moment; I'll be right back.
小丽，你去哪儿？ (Xiǎolì, nǐ qù nǎr?) - Xiaoli, where are you going?
你去哪儿我就去哪儿。 (Nǐ qù nǎr wǒ jiù qù nǎr.) - I'll go wherever you go.
我去洗手间。 (Wǒ qù xǐshǒujiān.) - I'm going to the restroom.
快五年了，你几乎没变化。 (Kuài wǔ nián le, nǐ jīhū méi biànhuà.) - It's been almost five years, and you've hardly changed.
谁说的？ (Shéi shuō de?) - Who says so?
我胖了，以前的衣服都不能穿了。 (Wǒ pàng le, yǐqián de yīfu dōu bù néng chuān le.) - I've put on weight; I can't wear my old clothes any more.
健康最重要，胖瘦没关系。 (Jiànkāng zuì zhòngyào, pàng shòu méi guānxi.) - Health is the most important; being fat or thin doesn't matter.
是呀，想吃什么就吃什么。 (Shì ya, xiǎng chī shénme jiù chī shénme.) - Yes, I eat whatever I feel like eating.
你做饭还是周明做饭？ (Nǐ zuò fàn háishi Zhōu Míng zuò fàn?) - Do you cook, or does Zhou Ming?
我做，我想吃什么就做什么，想吃多少就做多少。 (Wǒ zuò, wǒ xiǎng chī shénme jiù zuò shénme, xiǎng chī duōshao jiù zuò duōshao.) - I do. I cook whatever I want to eat, and as much as I want to eat.
上个星期我买了一条裤子，昨天又买了一条。 (Shàng ge xīngqī wǒ mǎile yì tiáo kùzi, zuótiān yòu mǎile yì tiáo.) - Last week I bought a pair of trousers, and yesterday I bought another pair.
你上午已经喝了一杯咖啡，下午怎么又喝了一杯？ (Nǐ shàngwǔ yǐjīng hēle yì bēi kāfēi, xiàwǔ zěnme yòu hēle yì bēi?) - You already drank a cup of coffee this morning; why did you drink another this afternoon?
小刚，你前天迟到，昨天迟到，今天怎么又迟到了？ (Xiǎogāng, nǐ qiántiān chídào, zuótiān chídào, jīntiān zěnme yòu chídào le?) - Xiaogang, you were late the day before yesterday and yesterday; why are you late again today?
我昨天看了一个电影，今天又看了一个。 (Wǒ zuótiān kànle yí ge diànyǐng, jīntiān yòu kànle yí ge.) - I watched a movie yesterday, and today I watched another.
你只吃了一点儿饭，再吃一点儿吧。 (Nǐ zhǐ chīle yìdiǎnr fàn, zài chī yìdiǎnr ba.) - You only ate a little; have a bit more.
家里只有一个面包了，我们再买一些吧。 (Jiāli zhǐ yǒu yí ge miànbāo le, wǒmen zài mǎi yìxiē ba.) - There's only one loaf of bread left at home; let's buy some more.
那个饭馆我昨天去了一次，明天还想再去一次。 (Nàge fànguǎn wǒ zuótiān qùle yí cì, míngtiān hái xiǎng zài qù yí cì.) - I went to that restaurant once yesterday, and I want to go once more tomorrow.
昨天去看了看，今天又去看了看，明天还要再去看看。 (Zuótiān qù kànle kàn, jīntiān yòu qù kànle kàn, míngtiān hái yào zài qù kànkan.) - I went to have a look yesterday, looked again today, and will look again tomorrow.
什么东西便宜我就买什么。 (Shénme dōngxi piányi wǒ jiù mǎi shénme.) - I'll buy whatever is cheap.
你哪天有时间就哪天来我家吧。 (Nǐ nǎ tiān yǒu shíjiān jiù nǎ tiān lái wǒ jiā ba.) - Come to my home on whichever day you have time.
谁喜欢他他就喜欢谁。 (Shéi xǐhuan tā tā jiù xǐhuan shéi.) - He likes whoever likes him.
你坐哪儿我就坐哪儿。 (Nǐ zuò nǎr wǒ jiù zuò nǎr.) - I'll sit wherever you sit.
你想喝点儿什么？ (Nǐ xiǎng hē diǎnr shénme?) - What would you like to drink?
我们什么时候去爬山？ (Wǒmen shénme shíhou qù pá shān?) - When shall we go mountain climbing?
你想跟谁一起去旅游？ (Nǐ xiǎng gēn shéi yìqǐ qù lǚyóu?) - Who would you like to travel with?
（那些房子）你都不满意吗？ ((Nàxiē fángzi) nǐ dōu bù mǎnyì ma?) - Are you dissatisfied with all (those houses)?
我害怕他。 (Wǒ hàipà tā.) - I'm afraid of him.
往下看多害怕啊。 (Wǎng xià kàn duō hàipà a.) - How scary it is to look down.
希望以后能再见面。 (Xīwàng yǐhòu néng zài jiàn miàn.) - I hope we can meet again in the future.
我一会儿再去。 (Wǒ yíhuìr zài qù.) - I'll go again in a moment.
你等我一会儿。 (Nǐ děng wǒ yíhuìr.) - Wait for me a moment.
你几乎没变化。 (Nǐ jīhū méi biànhuà.) - You've hardly changed.
不错，我玩儿得很高兴。 (Búcuò, wǒ wánr de hěn gāoxìng.) - Not bad, I had a great time.
周末你做什么了？ (Zhōumò nǐ zuò shénme le?) - What did you do at the weekend?
三点半吧。 (Sān diǎn bàn ba.) - Half past three.
是啊，我每天都运动。 (Shì a, wǒ měi tiān dōu yùndòng.) - Yes, I exercise every day.
这件衣服太贵了，别买了。 (Zhè jiàn yīfu tài guì le, bié mǎi le.) - This piece of clothing is too expensive; don't buy it.
您打算买什么样的？ (Nín dǎsuàn mǎi shénme yàng de?) - What kind are you planning to buy?
你的感冒不是刚好吗？ (Nǐ de gǎnmào bú shì gāng hǎo ma?) - Didn't your cold just get better?
昨天下大雨，我没带伞。 (Zuótiān xià dà yǔ, wǒ méi dài sǎn.) - It rained heavily yesterday and I didn't take an umbrella.
这两件衣服都很好看，你说我买哪件？ (Zhè liǎng jiàn yīfu dōu hěn hǎokàn, nǐ shuō wǒ mǎi nǎ jiàn?) - Both of these pieces look nice; which one do you say I should buy?
这件蓝色的怎么样？ (Zhè jiàn lánsè de zěnmeyàng?) - How about this blue one?
你已经有两件了。 (Nǐ yǐjīng yǒu liǎng jiàn le.) - You already have two.
小丽最近在做什么？ (Xiǎolì zuìjìn zài zuò shénme?) - What has Xiaoli been doing recently?
小丽为什么不满意？ (Xiǎolì wèi shénme bù mǎnyì?) - Why is Xiaoli not satisfied?
小明送给了马可什么东西？他为什么送马可东西？ (Xiǎomíng sònggěile Mǎkě shénme dōngxi? Tā wèi shénme sòng Mǎkě dōngxi?) - What did Xiaoming give Marco? Why did he give Marco something?
小丽和小刚在哪儿？做什么？ (Xiǎolì hé Xiǎogāng zài nǎr? Zuò shénme?) - Where are Xiaoli and Xiaogang? What are they doing?
小丽要去哪儿？小刚也去吗？ (Xiǎolì yào qù nǎr? Xiǎogāng yě qù ma?) - Where is Xiaoli going? Is Xiaogang going too?
周太太为什么说自己胖了？ (Zhōu tàitai wèi shénme shuō zìjǐ pàng le?) - Why does Mrs. Zhou say she has put on weight?
你打算去哪儿旅游？ (Nǐ dǎsuàn qù nǎr lǚyóu?) - Where are you planning to travel?
哪儿好玩儿我就去哪儿。 (Nǎr hǎowánr wǒ jiù qù nǎr.) - I'll go wherever is fun.
什么时候去？ (Shénme shíhou qù?) - When will you go?
怎么去？ (Zěnme qù?) - How will you go?
跟谁一起去？ (Gēn shéi yìqǐ qù?) - Who will you go with?
住在哪儿？ (Zhù zài nǎr?) - Where will you stay?
到了旅游的地方吃什么？ (Dàole lǚyóu de dìfang chī shénme?) - What will you eat when you get to the travel destination?
我去过两次北京，2000年去了一次，前年又去了一次。 (Wǒ qùguo liǎng cì Běijīng, èr líng líng líng nián qùle yí cì, qiánnián yòu qùle yí cì.) - I have been to Beijing twice: once in 2000, and again the year before last.
我去了长城。 (Wǒ qùle Chángchéng.) - I went to the Great Wall.
我打算再去一次北京，再去一次长城。 (Wǒ dǎsuàn zài qù yí cì Běijīng, zài qù yí cì Chángchéng.) - I plan to go to Beijing once more, and to the Great Wall once more.
站得高，看得远。 (Zhàn de gāo, kàn de yuǎn.) - The higher you stand, the farther you'll see.

"站得高，看得远"的意思是，站在高的地方，就能看到更远的地方。 ("Zhàn de gāo, kàn de yuǎn" de yìsi shì, zhàn zài gāo de dìfang, jiù néng kàndào gèng yuǎn de dìfang.) - It means that standing in a high place, you can see farther places.

这句话也用来比喻不能只从一个方面看问题，多考虑几个方面，才能更加全面。 (Zhè jù huà yě yònglái bǐyù bù néng zhǐ cóng yí ge fāngmiàn kàn wèntí, duō kǎolǜ jǐ ge fāngmiàn, cáinéng gèngjiā quánmiàn.) - It is also used metaphorically: do not view a problem from one aspect only; consider several aspects to be more comprehensive.
